description: Heading slugs follow GitHub's rule, and getHeaders reports the slug each heading would get.

tests.description: Punctuation is dropped, hyphens and underscores are kept, spaces become hyphens
Letters of any alphabet are kept and lowercased
Superscript and circled digits are dropped, an emoji variation selector is kept
The slug is cut to 40 characters without splitting a character outside the BMP
tests.action: const a = 'a'.repeat(39); expect(MU.headingSlug(a + '𝒜𝒜')).toBe(a + '𝒜'); expect(MU.headingSlug('This paragraph text is long enough to be cut at forty characters')).toBe('this-paragraph-text-is-long-enough-to-be')

tests.description: Repeated slugs are numbered by position, counting every heading with the same slug
getHeaders reports the slug each heading would get, numbered by position in the document
tests.action: const h = JSON.parse(MU.getHeaders()); expect(h.map(x => x.text + ':' + x.slug)).toEqual(['Intro:intro', 'Setup:setup', 'Setup:setup-1'])
